title: Handoff to Sales
seo: Handoff from sales chat to your team
meta: Warm leads passed from the assistant to a person with the full conversation, in real time or by email. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Handoff to sales, with the whole conversation attached
overview: An assistant should know when to step aside. We set rules for when a conversation moves to a person, for example a large order, a custom request or a shopper who asks for a human. The team member gets an alert with the chat history, the products viewed and what the shopper wants. During working hours the shopper joins a live chat. Outside hours the assistant takes their details and promises a reply time you set.

faq: How does it know when to hand off?
By rules we agree with you: the shopper asks for a person, the basket value is high, the question is about a custom order or the assistant is unsure. We test each rule so it triggers when it should.
A short, friendly message that a person is joining, plus a clear time to expect a reply when no one is online. No shopper is left wondering whether anyone is coming.
Which tools does this work with?
Common chat tools such as Intercom, Tidio, Gorgias chat and similar. We check what yours supports, and tell you what we can set up before we begin.
Nobody must be, as the out of hours path takes details and sends an alert for the morning. You set the hours, and we test both paths, so nothing falls through the gap.
